name: @starci/cli
description: The starci command line: one TypeScript source, core verbs plus the lite and full edition verbs.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const d of ['ops','policy']) require('node:fs').cpSync('../'+d, d, {recursive: true})"
scripts.postpack: node -e "for (const d of ['ops','policy']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})"
